raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to efficiently identify and gather the comprehensive list of Fidelity international emerging markets equity mutual funds with $0 transaction fees and their historical performance data between May 2019 and May 2024. Despite multiple interactions and clear instructions from the orchestrator to use Fidelity's Fund Screener tool, WebSurfer repeatedly clicked on irrelevant links and did not successfully apply the filters to retrieve the required list of funds. This repeated inefficiency ultimately led to the wrong solution being provided (FEMKX instead of FPADX).
